summary.prose: Replace automated design and code reviews with stateless unavailable endpoints, then delete their engines and all live wiring. Remove automated-review requirements from workflow gates while preserving human approvals, build/task checks, shared daemon services and historical reads. Validate the exact endpoint contracts, absence of side effects, remaining guards, current client behavior and clean packaged output using user-authorized self-checks.

tasks.title: Retain review endpoints as stateless rewritten errors
tasks.summary: Freeze existing MCP schemas and exact 27-operation inventory. Isolate public schema definitions from execution contracts, replace MCP/step/IPC/legacy review entrypoints with family-specific errors, remove MCP persistent review connections, and preserve ordinary error transport and human decision endpoints. Remove/bypass review-specific host/router ownership allocation before unavailable dispatch; defer deletion of orphan ownership infrastructure to t3.
acceptanceChecks: All 2 MCP tools and 25 IPC review methods remain registered with unchanged callable MCP schemas and accepted phase sets.
Every valid review operation reports the exact family-specific rewritten error without repo resolution, provider/file access, worker/process creation or retained MCP connections.
Human workflow.reviewDecision and generic artifact/team endpoints remain outside automated-review retirement.
Unavailable review dispatch allocates no review owner in step host or router before reaching the error handler.

tests.name: All preserved review operations and accepted MCP phases report exact rewrite errors without allocating review state
Repeated unavailable MCP calls allocate no persistent review connections and preserve transport error envelopes

tasks.title: Decouple approval and completion from automated reviews
tasks.summary: Remove automated-review gates, party/freshness/approval fences and cleanup hooks from workflow/lifecycle approval and Story/Epic completion. Extract minimal dependency-free historical schema/read/render contracts where generic artifact views require them, preserving data and all non-review guards. Historical schema/readers must have a dependency-free inert closure; do not preserve entire execution-contract trees.
acceptanceChecks: Human artifact approval and completion of approved validated builds with passing current tasks work without any CR or review override.
Integrity, upstream approval, team/signoff, build and task-accounting denials still apply; no fake clean review or altered historical verdict is written.
Approval/completion and generic historical reads do not load review execution or call cleanup endpoints; representative stored review versions remain readable.
Transitive imports of generic historical readers and preserved public schemas contain no review execution, provider, worker, checkpoint-writing or cleanup modules.

tests.name: Human approval and Story Epic completion work without CR while non-review integrity build task and team guards remain effective
Historical review versions remain readable unchanged through an inert dependency closure

tasks.title: Remove review runtime wiring from shared daemon services
tasks.summary: Detach ProductionReviews, dedicated workers/native/preparation/resource/cleanup owners, router/request ownership and live review progress producer registration. Preserve shared ThreadServices, worker hub/step state, process broker/providers and ordinary index/analyze/workflow task progress.
acceptanceChecks: Daemon startup/shutdown and normal requests allocate no review worker, runtime service, recovery scan, preparation or cleanup owner.
Shared ThreadServices, ordinary daemon worker routing, step state, provider broker and unrelated progress validation still function.
Historical review task rows remain inert/readable; no fabricated live or completed review progress is published.

tests.name: Daemon startup shutdown and dispatch create no review services workers progress producers or cleanup owners
Normal ThreadServices worker routing step state provider broker and task progress continue without review hooks

tasks.title: Delete obsolete review implementation and update operational guidance
tasks.summary: Delete now-unreachable review engines, preparation/checkpoint/publication/cleanup/activation code, review-only helpers/assets/config/prompts and obsolete implementation tests. Update canonical steering/user guidance and current client metadata for unavailable endpoints and human approval. Keep only endpoint/schema/error and generic historical read compatibility, with no dormant execution trees.
acceptanceChecks: No executable review engine, worker/bootstrap/native host, activation, checkpoint writer, publication or cleanup implementation remains in production imports or shipped output.

Remaining review-named files contain only endpoint schemas/errors, historical data/read/render types or explicitly preserved human artifact decisions; shared packages and generic analyze adherence remain.
Guidance and current IDE configuration match endpoint unavailability and removal of automated-review requirements; repository history artifacts/checkpoints are unchanged.

tests.name: Production source import and asset audit retains only review endpoints inert historical readers and human decisions
Review unavailability guidance and settings agree across backend VS Code and JetBrains contracts

tasks.title: Verify complete removal and compatibility with self-check evidence
tasks.summary: Run focused production-registration, no-side-effect, human approval/completion, historical read and unrelated service checks; clean production build and inspect packaged output for stale runtime files; verify both current IDE clients surface errors without polling. Record self-check evidence and limitations without invoking broken automated reviews or deploying/restarting the daemon.
acceptanceChecks: Endpoint/schema inventory and exact error contracts pass across accepted phases and unary/stream/MCP dispatch; repeated failures allocate no review state/connections.
Missing/failed BUILD, stale/incomplete task set, integrity/team/signoff/upstream refusal checks remain effective; valid human-approved work completes without CR.
Clean build removes planted stale review output; package/import inspection finds no deleted runtime; historical fixtures/hashes and both current IDE client error contracts pass.
Self-review evidence records actual commands/results and limitations; no installed-daemon update, restart or automated-review certification is claimed.

tests.name: Clean production build and package contain no deleted review implementation or planted stale review output
End-to-end unavailable review calls preserve historical data and do not start client polling or unrelated service regressions
